fields.median_household_income: Median household income, USD. Null if Census-suppressed.
fields.pct_hispanic: % Hispanic or Latino (any race). 0-100, null if no data.
fields.pct_black_nh: % Black or African American, not Hispanic. 0-100.
fields.pct_other_nh: % Other (AIAN + NHPI + Other + Two+), not Hispanic. 0-100.
fields.population_density: People per square mile. Float or null.

_meta.source: US Census ACS 5-year 2023 estimates (tables B01003, B19013, B03002). Polygon areas computed from zip_layer.geojson via spherical excess.
